description: Use this when the user wants the words: speech in an audio or video file turned into text, from a podcast, interview, lecture, meeting or voice note. Accepts a file the user attached (file) or a direct https link to a media file such as .mp3, .m4a, .wav or .mp4 (url). Returns the transcript with speaker turns, plus a page with the full text and .txt, .srt and .vtt downloads. Short files finish in this call; longer ones return status "processing" and a transcription_id for transcription_status. Up to 1 hour per file. The first transcript needs no account; after that it asks for a Slice sign-in, and a signed-in person gets 2 transcripts a month, shared with the Slice website. Do not use when the user wants short video clips made from a video (start_episode does that), for YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts or other web pages (they are pages, not files), for text already in the conversation, or for live audio.

file.description: An audio or video file the user attached in the conversation.

url.description: A direct https link to an audio or video file, e.g. https://example.com/episode.mp3. Not a web page.

wait.description: Default true: wait briefly so short files come back finished. False returns at once with a transcription_id.

name: transcribe_audio

duplicate.description: True when this is the transcript already made of the same file earlier: nothing new was started or counted. Do not send the file again.

results_url.description: Page with the full transcript and downloads. No sign-in; share it only with people who should see the transcript.

transcript.description: The transcript in paragraphs, with speaker labels when there is more than one voice.

transcript_truncated.description: True when only the first part is included here; the results page has all of it.

title: Transcribe audio or video
